task: 5.3 two-path candidate fusion (merge / identity dedup / version constraints, read-only, guarded)
command_run: uv run env-rag-final fuse-candidates --query-id fact-002,syn-001,neg-001 --report-dir reports/pg-retrieval/phase-3-fusion

inputs.pg_path: search.query.run_query(expand=False); fusion consumes discovery_candidates ONLY (explicit [] = authoritative zero discovery; enumeration never backfills)
inputs.shared_identity: gold question text + workspace per query; source/catalog/search/gold/env guards before/after

merge_contract.dedup: same identity merges the candidate; ALL paths kept (score kinds: pg_ts_rank / local_selection_order / none)
merge_contract.scores: raw kinds preserved verbatim; never summed, converted or fabricated (no cosine, no joint score)
merge_contract.doc_conflict: conflicting attribution -> entry rejected, no attribution picked
merge_contract.typed_targets: doc/scope/table targets stay typed; only real chunk identities become chunk candidates

version_constraints.local_binding: local chunks outside resolved target docs are rejected (marked, propagated to merged entry)
version_constraints.missing_targets: kept missing; nearby versions never substitute; retained evidence for other targets kept
version_constraints.all_missing: local call skipped entirely (zero model calls)
version_constraints.multi_version: each resolved (code, version) branch allowed; cross-version candidates kept

budget.rule: first-seen (PG discovery order, then local order); truncation recorded with unretained ids; status partial, never complete

degrade_contract.local_failure: explicit pg-only-degraded with real error + failing adapter receipts
degrade_contract.pg_stale: stale status; local output never upgrades it
degrade_contract.stage_check: fusion re-checks local per-stage completeness records (stage_completeness); global label/one boolean not trusted alone

syn-001.rejected_reason: candidate docs (doc-8bd9..., doc-c963..., doc-eb0a...) are not RESOLVED requested targets (GB3095-2012/2026); nearby versions never substitute

neg-001.local_skipped: all requested targets missing; local call skipped (zero model calls)

content_readback: every usable candidate read back from production public.lightrag_doc_chunks by (workspace, chunk_id); full text + content_sha256 retained; content_head never treated as full text

pg_only_smoke.command: uv run env-rag-final fuse-candidates --query-id neg-001 --pg-only --report-dir reports/pg-retrieval/phase-3-fusion-smoke
pg_only_smoke.result: neg-001 missing, usable=0, zero model calls (switch wired end-to-end in the real CLI)
